biology.respiration-mcq-rev.0003.all: Produces ethanol and carbon dioxide without using oxygen

biology.respiration-prac-method.0003.all: mix yeast with glucose solution in tube; cover with oil layer (anaerobic); delivery tube into limewater; warm water bath ~35 C; control with boiled yeast; observe limewater turning cloudy over time

biology.respiration-prac-plan.0001.all: plan: germinating seeds in vacuum flask vs boiled (dead) seeds disinfected; thermometer through cotton wool plug; same mass seeds, same starting temp, same flask type; record temp daily for several days; repeat

biology.respiration-prac-reliab.0002.a: identify anomalies, calculate mean; biological variation, more reliable
biology.respiration-prac-reliab.0002.b: respirometer with glass beads (same volume/mass) instead of woodlice; shows drop movement is due to woodlice respiration, not temperature/pressure changes

biology.respiration-prac-risk.0001.a: glass thermometer/flask breaking - handle with care / microbes on peas - wash hands
biology.respiration-prac-risk.0001.b: read thermometer at eye level / use digital temperature probe / leave to equilibrate

biology.respiration-prac-step.0005.all: to allow woodlice/air in respirometer to reach the temperature of the water bath (equilibrate) so readings are at the stated temperature; and woodlice to acclimatise / pressure to stabilise

biology.respiration-prac-vars.0003.a: presence of yeast/whether yeast is living (or temperature)
biology.respiration-prac-vars.0003.b: whether limewater turns cloudy / time to turn cloudy
biology.respiration-prac-vars.0003.c: temperature; glucose concentration/volume; mass of yeast; volume of limewater

biology.transport-plants-data-graph.0003.a: as humidity increases, rate of transpiration decreases (negative correlation); quote values
biology.transport-plants-data-graph.0003.b: higher humidity, more water vapour in air; smaller concentration gradient between air spaces and air; slower diffusion out of stomata

biology.transport-plants-data-pct.0004.b: higher humidity reduces water vapour concentration gradient between leaf and air; less diffusion of water vapour out through stomata; slower transpiration

biology.transport-plants-data-plot.0002.a: axes labelled, scale, points correct, smooth curve
biology.transport-plants-data-plot.0002.b: rate increases from 3 to 14 mm/min between 0 and 3 m/s, then levels off at 14 mm/min

biology.transport-plants-data-read.0002.c: wind removes water vapour from around leaf; maintains steep concentration gradient; faster diffusion out of stomata so more water uptake

biology.transport-plants-describe.0002.all: water leaves xylem into mesophyll cells by osmosis; evaporates from mesophyll cell surfaces into air spaces; water vapour diffuses out through stomata

biology.transport-plants-describe-multi..b: xylem transports water and mineral ions from roots up to leaves; phloem transports sucrose and amino acids (translocation) from leaves to other parts, both directions

biology.transport-plants-explain.0004.all: tree has small SA:V ratio; diffusion too slow over long distances to supply all cells; alga has large SA:V and short diffusion distance so diffusion is enough

biology.transport-plants-explain-multi.0.b: long extension gives large surface area; thin cell wall/short diffusion distance; many mitochondria for active transport of mineral ions; concentrated cell sap for osmosis

biology.transport-plants-mcq.0003.all: the rate of water uptake by a shoot

biology.transport-plants-mcq-rev.0005.all: Reduces transpiration by lowering the water vapour gradient

biology.transport-plants-prac-method.000.all: cut shoot under water, assemble potometer underwater, seal with vaseline; introduce air bubble; place fan at set distance, leave to acclimatise; measure distance bubble moves in set time; repeat at different distances; same temperature/light

biology.transport-plants-prac-plan.0002.all: plan: potometer with leafy shoot (or weigh plants) at range of 5 temperatures; same plant/leaf area, light intensity, humidity, air movement; acclimatise, measure bubble distance in fixed time; repeat 3x, mean

biology.transport-plants-prac-reliab.000.a: identify anomalies, calculate mean; more reliable
biology.transport-plants-prac-reliab.000.b: potometer with no fan (still air) as control; shows effect of fan / baseline rate

biology.transport-plants-prac-risk.0002.a: heavy pots/electrical heaters or hot surfaces - handle carefully; soil microbes - wash hands
biology.transport-plants-prac-risk.0002.b: use a more precise balance (0.01 g) / zero balance before each weighing

biology.transport-plants-prac-step.0004.all: prevents water evaporating from the soil; so mass loss is only due to transpiration from leaves

biology.transport-plants-prac-vars.0001.b: distance moved by air bubble in set time
biology.transport-plants-prac-vars.0001.c: temperature; light intensity; same shoot/leaf area; humidity; time

biology.transport-plants-recall.0001.all: loss of water vapour from the leaves (by evaporation and diffusion through stomata)

biology.respiration-prac-plan.0001.fix: C – compare living germinating peas with boiled (dead) peas that have been disinfected.
